m: The {King} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} and grumbles that his garden *shed* is too small for his crowns. A giant *helping hand* grabs the walls and stretches them like chewing gum. The shed swells to the size of a stadium. The king keeps shouting "**enlarge**!", so the hand **enlarges** it until it swallows the warehouse.

The {Gardener} pops up through the {Trapdoor} on the {Island} with a *sheep* that won't stop eating. She drops a huge silver *dish* over it like a **lid**: clang! The sheep bleats from inside, so she stacks a pot **lid**, a bin lid and a manhole cover on top, and the whole pile baas.

The {Ninja} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lagoon} and finds a lazy *king* lying in the *grass*, waving a list of chores. "What should I **do**?" the king asks. The ninja **does** everything at once: mows, sweeps, juggles fish, paints the lagoon, in a blur of black pyjamas.

The {Shepherd} marches up the {Staircase} of the {Youth Club} beside a *sparrow* flexing a huge *upper arm*. The sparrow puffs its chest, shows off its muscles and crows like a rooster. It's the most **male** bird in the world, and every **male** in the club tries to arm-wrestle it and loses.

The {Wizard} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Funfair}, his *racing heart* pounding, balancing a single *grain stalk* on his nose. The rollercoaster thunders overhead and the floor shakes, but he stays **steady**. Not a wobble. Children stack teacups on the grain, and he keeps it **steady** all night.

The {Wizard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} and trips over a *tombstone* engraved with his own name. His *heart* skips. Who buried him? He can't remember. He **forgets** his spells, his hat, his way out. Then he **forgets** that he forgot, and happily flies off on a broom he thinks is a plane.

The {Yogi} rises through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Beach} and counts swans. A *standing person* points: another *swan*, and another. They multiply until there are a **hundred million** swans honking, covering the sand, the sea and the sky. The yogi keeps counting calmly, all **hundred million** of them, one breath per swan.

The {Tsar} plummets through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} and sits on a huge *thorn*. OUCH! A *standing knife* next to it can't cut it free. The **thorn** sticks to his royal bottom while the bees laugh. He waddles back to the throne, and the throne now has a **thorn** on it too.

The {Yogi} on the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} spreads her arms wide and **embraces** everyone who climbs up: tourists, crabs, the postman. A giant *helping hand* carries a *bucket* of fish and she hugs that too. She **embraces** the whole lagoon until the water wraps its waves around her.

The {Tailor} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Pool}, followed by a puffing *runner* who copies her *footsteps* exactly. Every stitch she sews, he sews. Every dive, he dives. He is her devoted **disciple**, and soon a hundred **disciples** march behind her, all wearing tape measures.

The {Magician} clatters into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, where a stern *woman* with an umbrella is babysitting a hundred toddlers. She's the **nanny**, and a better *mother* than anyone. She pulls rubber ducks from her handbag. The magician tries a trick, but the **nanny** out-tricks him with a floating pram.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hangar}, where a tall skinny *tree* has sprouted through the roof, its leaves glittering in the *sun rays*. It's a **poplar**, shaking and whispering in the wind. Planes park in its shade, and the yogi does a tree pose beside the **poplar**, much shorter.

The {Cheerleader} bounces up the {Staircase} of the {Beach} club with giant scissors and trims everything into a perfect *trimmed hedge*: palm trees, sandcastles, the lifeguard's hair. Everything is **neat**, square and level. She even trims the waves until the sea is **neat** as a carpet.

The {Sailor} bursts out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Island} with a starter pistol. Bang! A **competition** begins: crabs race across the *roof* of the beach hut, coconuts roll downhill and seagulls sprint. The sailor commentates, gets too excited and joins the **competition** himself, in flippers.

The {Cheerleader} pops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} chasing a *runner* who snatched a vase with one *grabbing hand*. Pom-poms flying, she follows him past mummies and suits of armour. It's the most **interesting** tour ever, and the visitors follow, cheering, finding everything suddenly **interesting**.

The {Cheerleader} on the {Rooftop} of the {Museum} sings a *song* so wobbly that everything around her bends. The flagpole kinks, the chimney twists and the statues lean over. The whole skyline goes **crooked**, and the museum curator straightens his **crooked** glasses in despair.

The {Dentist} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} sharpening a giant *knife* that flashes in the sun. Pigeons gasp. She uses the **knife** to slice clouds into neat cubes, to cut the wind and to trim the moon. The tower dwellers duck as the **knife** spins back like a boomerang.

The {Chef} squelches up the {Staircase} of the {Swamp} cabin and finds a *tree* growing out of a *shed*. He chops it, carves it and builds a giant **bed**, then cooks breakfast in it. Frogs leap into the blanket, alligators fluff the pillows, and the chef snores in the **bed** with a frying pan.

The {Yogi} stands on the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring}, lifting her *upward gaze* to the sky as a hot-air balloon drifts down the *road*. She throws petals and bangs a gong to **welcome** the passengers: astronauts, grannies, a goat. Boxers line up to **welcome** them with soft punches.

The {Baker} slips across the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring}, where *water* poured from a hose has frozen into dangling *icicles*. Everything is **ice**: ice gloves, ice ropes, ice bell. The baker skates round the ring juggling frozen buns, and the boxers fight in skates on the **ice**.

The {Shepherd} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Museum}, which looks out over old *ruins*. He opens the exhibit cases: **empty**. The frames: empty. The ticket booth: empty. Even the gift shop is just echoes. He shouts "hello?" and his echo replies "**empty**!" from every corner.

The {Wizard} skips up the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} with a *king* who flips a *yuan coin* to see who's "it". Heads! They **play** hide and seek, tag and hopscotch through every hallway. The wizard cheats with spells, and the king **plays** by hiding inside a chandelier.

The {Shepherd} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} hut with a *woodcutter*, who splits a log into tiny pieces. They **analyze** every splinter under a magnifying glass, sorting grain, knots and beetle tunnels into charts. The seagulls want to **analyze** the sandwiches, so the woodcutter splits those too.

The {Chef} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Swamp} hut, where steam pours from a *chimney* built into a *cave*. He knocks a hole in the wall to let the smoke out. Now it's a **window**! Frogs peer in, mosquitoes peer in, and the chef hangs curtains on the **window** made of spaghetti.

The {Shepherd} snores in the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring}, hugging a *wine jug*. Then a falling *star* crashes through the roof and bonks him on the nose. He **wakes up**! Bells ring, boxers shout, sheep bleat, and everyone else in the stadium **wakes up** too, in their pyjamas.

The {Cheerleader} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} villa, waving pom-poms at a bride in flip-flops. It's her new *wife*, who parachutes in wearing a veil. They throw a beach party on the roof, and the **wife** wins the sandcastle contest while the cheerleader cheers her **wife** louder than the sea.

The {Tailor} pops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} as water begins to **seep through** the floorboards. A pink *blossom* drifts in on the trickle, then another, from a *road* outside. The leak grows; flowers, fish and frogs **seep through** every crack, and the boathouse becomes a soggy garden.

The {Gardener} climbs through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} with a fishing *hook* and dangles it into a pile of *shell* money. He **purchases** a canoe, a lifebuoy and a pet seal, paying with seashells. The shopkeeper accepts, so he **purchases** the boathouse too, and the lake.

The {Tailor} drops through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Beach} volleyball court, where the star player has twisted an ankle. The coach sends in a *substitute*: a walrus. Then another **substitute**: a beach umbrella. Finally the tailor herself **substitutes**, and wins with a needle serve.

The {Sailor} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Island} hut and **stuffs in** everything he owns through a hole in the *roof*: hammocks, coconuts, a canoe, three parrots. The hut bulges. He **stuffs in** one more banana, and the walls burst, scattering his belongings over the whole island.

The {Ninja} sweats in the {Basement} of the {Pool}, a tired *drudge* pushing an enormous boulder up the ladder with one *strong arm*. Push, slip, push again. He **strives** all night, grunting. At dawn the boulder plops into the pool, and the ninja **strives** to fish it out again.

The {Shepherd} flops onto the {Rooftop} of the {Youth Hostel} beside a *standing person* leaning against a shady *tree*. They both sigh and **rest**. The sheep **rest** too, then the clouds stop drifting, the backpackers stop talking, and the whole city takes a nap under one tree.

The {Hunter} tiptoes into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, rifle shaking, and finds a *crouching tiger* in a swimming cap. The **tiger** stretches, roars, and does a perfect backstroke. The hunter drops his gun and applauds. He buys the **tiger** a towel and they share the hot tub.

The {Yogi} bounds up the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} and lifts a giant *helping hand* toward the *sun rays*. She **raises** a plane over her head, then a flag, then the roof. Everyone cheers and **raises** their arms, and the hangar floats upward like a balloon.

The {Tailor} hurries down the {Staircase} of the {Pool} and follows a *road* paved with *leftovers*: half a sandwich, a banana peel, cold noodles. Seagulls swoop. She marks the **route** on a map with thread. The **route** leads to a picnic where a bear is eating the rest.

The {Cheerleader} on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} spots a *standing person* sneaking over the wall with a ladder, then a hundred more. They **invade** the inn: they steal the pillows, eat the porridge and occupy the bathtubs. The cheerleader chants "No **invading**!" and they all cheer back.

The {Shepherd} trudges up the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring}, where a referee has locked a cheating boxer in wooden *stocks*. His **punishment**: the crowd throws custard pies. Splat, splat, splat! The shepherd's sheep lick the custard off his face, which is the worst **punishment** of all.

The {Lifeguard} climbs through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum}, tugging a spool of *silk thread* dyed a shocking **green**. She ties it to the *logbook* and swings it round; everything it touches turns green: statues, paintings, the guards' noses. By lunchtime the museum is completely **green**.

The {Shepherd} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Youth Club} beside his *big brother*, who is ten feet tall and wears a cape. His **elder brother** lifts him up, carries the sheep, fixes the chimney and wins every game. The shepherd sulks, but his **elder brother** gives him a piggyback to the moon.

The {Shepherd} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Dunes} house onto a *road* where a *swift* bird zips past faster than sound. He chases it on a camel. Whoosh! The camel is so **rapid** it skids across the dunes, leaving rapid dust clouds, and the swift waves from far ahead, even more **rapid**.

The {Tailor} rises through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} with a giant sock, ready to **cover** a *big man* with wild *flowing locks*. She yanks it over his head. His hair still escapes, so she adds a tent, a duvet and a tarp. The tower is now **covered** too.

The {Magician} vanishes through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} into a busy market, where traders bang a wooden *mortise* together and swap a *shell* for a sheep. Shouting, haggling, juggling. The magician joins the **trade**, swapping rabbits for teapots, and the tower becomes a world **trade** fair.

The {Baker} pops out of the {Trapdoor} onto the {Beach} where *twins* are racing to the *cross* marked in the sand. They sprint, dive, tumble. Both **finish** at the same moment, panting. The baker hands them cupcakes and **finishes** the race himself an hour later, crawling.

The {Wizard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Lake} house and finds a *sparrow* with a big *mouth* singing alone. The **only** bird left; the others flew south. The wizard turns the stairs into a choir stand, but the sparrow refuses to share. It's the **only** singer and it knows it.

The {Gardener} descends into the {Basement} of the {Pool} and finds a hidden *valley*: mountains on both sides, a river down the middle and sheep grazing. She plants carrots on the slopes. Swimmers wander in and get lost in the **valley**, and the pool becomes the deepest **valley** in town.

The {Lifeguard} rolls down the {Staircase} of the {Casino} on a *cart* with one giant **wheel**. It bumps over a *neat stack* of poker chips and they scatter. The roulette wheel joins in, then every wheel in town rolls inside, and the casino becomes a racetrack of **wheels**.

The {King} pops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and finds a secret *warehouse* under the deep end. Inside are rows of rubber ducks, inflatable flamingos and old swimsuits, stacked to the ceiling. He declares it the royal **warehouse** and hires a duck to guard the **warehouse** door.

The {Juggler} pops up through the {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} and follows a *road* of sweaty footprints left by a *sweating man*. Every **trace** shows him jogging, crying, buying ice cream. She follows every **trace** until she finds him asleep under a towel, still sweating.

The {Yogi} clambers up the {Staircase} of the {Boathouse} and discovers she has a magical *wart* on her nose that glows. Everything is beautiful, **especially** the wart. Boats, waves, seagulls, all lovely, but **especially** the wart, which she paints gold and shows off to everyone.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boxing Ring} and leaps onto a *podium*, where a *big brother* in a cape challenges her to **compete**. Who can juggle more knives? They **compete** for hours, adding swords, eggs and kittens, until both stand on the podium tied.

The {Juggler} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Yeti Cave} and paints a *crossroads* onto the snow, then props up a *jade tablet* as a street sign. Instantly a **street** appears: lamp posts, cafés, a bus full of yetis. She juggles traffic cones at the junction while yetis honk up and down the **street**.

The {Tsar} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and stomps one huge *foot*. "**Hurry**!" A *standing person* in a dressing gown jumps in, swims ten laps in three seconds and climbs out. The tsar stamps again, and every swimmer **hurries** so fast that the water sloshes out over the town.

The {Yogi} walks down the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} onto a *stretching road* that keeps getting longer. Every step she takes, it grows another mile. She stretches too, arms reaching across rivers, legs crossing valleys. She **extends** the road around the world, and then **extends** her lunch break to match.

The {Jockey} crashes through the {Trapdoor} of the {Funfair}, and a giant *clam* in the ghost train slams shut under the *rain*. BOOM! The ground starts to **shake**. The ferris wheel wobbles, candy floss trembles, the dodgems bounce. Everything **shakes** like jelly, and the jockey's horse dances to the rhythm.

The {Cheerleader} drops through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Beach} with a pram full of tall *grass*. She waves her pom-poms, gets bored, and **abandons** the pram by a sandcastle. Then she **abandons** her shoes, her whistle and her team, and wanders off to start a new career as a crab.

The {Juggler} clanks into the {Basement} of the {Piazza} wearing shiny *armour* and wins every contest down there: arm-wrestling, pizza eating, spaghetti juggling. **First** in everything! She wears a gold medal on her helmet, and the pigeons bow to the **first** knight of the square.

The {Wizard} rummages in the {Basement} of the {Lake} house and finds a tiny *standing person* tied with a *leather strap*. Untied, he grows and grows, until he's a giant who builds bridges with one hand. A **great** man! The wizard is too short to hug him, so he hugs his **great** toe.

The {Magician} creeps up the {Staircase} of the {Spa} carrying a bundle of scratchy *hemp*. He weaves it into towels, robes and slippers. Guests itch and squirm. "Natural **hemp**!" he cries, and pulls a rope of **hemp** from his sleeve that never ends, until the spa is knee-deep in it.

The {Chef} stirs a pot on the {Rooftop} of the {Swan Pond} pavilion, and soup overflows into a roaring *river*. It rushes down the roof, across the lawn and out to sea. Swans paddle on it. The chef keeps stirring, and the **river** of broth grows wider, a delicious **river** that smells of noodles.

The {Sheriff} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Funfair} ticket booth and holds up a long *skewer* stacked with kebabs. Megaphone on, she **states** the rules: no cutting queues, no feeding seagulls, no laughing at the clowns. She **states** them so firmly that the skewer stands to attention and so does the rollercoaster.

The {Hunter} dangles into the {Basement} of the {Swan Pond} pavilion on a *rescue rope* made of *silk thread*. It lowers him **slow**, slower, slowest. A snail overtakes him. The swans fall asleep watching. By the time he lands it's next week, and everything in the pavilion has gone **slow** too.

The {Cheerleader} sneaks up the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange}, dripping *water drops*, because she's a secret agent. A *substitute* teller takes her place at the desk. She stays **hidden** inside a vault, a periscope poking out of a coin purse. Nobody knows she's there; she's **hidden** for twelve years.

The {Sheriff} bursts into the {Basement} of the {Mansion} through a creaky *gate*, and a *person* flings pies at her. She **dodges**: left, right, backflip. Custard misses her by inches. She **dodges** so fast she leaves a blur, and the pies hit the butler instead.

The {Sheriff} pops out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} and sets up a stall with a *sparrow* that shouts through its big *mouth*: "Boats for **sale**!" It **sells** rowing boats, canoes, a submarine and a duck. Everything goes. The sparrow even tries to **sell** the sheriff.

The {Dentist} hammers a *nail* into the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} treehouse and hangs a jar with a tiny *campfire* in it. It's a **lamp**! Moths, monkeys and fireflies gather round to read, and the dentist checks their teeth by the light of the **lamp**.

The {Jockey} on the {Rooftop} of the {Funfair} threads a giant **needle** with a string of *gold coins* and stitches the sky into a *cross* pattern. Clouds get sewn into quilts. A kite tangles in the thread. She sews the moon on tight with her **needle**, so it never wanders off.

The {Jockey} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hut} to see a **wise** old owl holding a *snapped stick* and opening its *mouth* to speak. Every word is a riddle that solves itself. The jockey asks "Why?" and the owl answers "Because." It's the most **wise** thing she has ever heard, and she writes it on her saddle.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} and finds a giant spider weaving *silk thread* between every shelf. A lost *visitor* is tangled in the middle. The threads link every box, every forklift, every phone. It's a **network**, and every tug sends news across the **network** in seconds.

The {Dentist} digs into the {Basement} of the {Beach} house as a huge wave crashes in. She plants a *helping hand* against the *foundation* and pushes back. She **resists** the wave, the tide and a passing whale. Soaked but standing, she keeps **resisting** until the sea gives up and goes home.

The {Jockey} gallops across the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} spilling a pot of *red lacquer* everywhere. The tiles turn **vermilion**, the slide turns vermilion, the swimmers come out glowing like lobsters. She paints her horse **vermilion** too, and it shines like a fire engine.

The {Ghost} floats up to the {Rooftop} of the {Island} lighthouse and sneezes on a pile of *soil*. A huge cloud of **dust** puffs out, swirling into a tiny *full stop* that hangs in the air. Everyone coughs. The ghost sneezes again, more **dust**, until the island looks like a giant snow globe of grime.

The {Baker} tumbles through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} with a giant *parcel* that won't stop wriggling. A *helping hand* tries to take it, but the baker **holds** it tight. Inside: a puppy. He **holds** it all night, singing lullabies, and it falls asleep in his apron.

The {Gardener} bangs a fat *branch* on a giant *drum* in the {Basement} of the {Pool}. BOOM! The water jumps out of the pool. BOOM! The tiles rattle. She plays the **drum** faster and the swimmers dance underwater, while the **drum** booms like thunder through every pipe in town.

The {Jockey} skips down the {Staircase} of the {Beehive}, dangling a *plumb line* to check that every hole is straight, then **plants** a *tree* in each one. Saplings sprout everywhere: in the honey, in the queen's bed, on the stairs. She **plants** so many that the beehive becomes a forest.

The {Chef} glides down the {Staircase} of the {Casino} in a white apron spun from *silk thread*, carrying a pot of snow-white soup from his mountain *camp*. Everything he touches turns **pure**: dice turn white, cards go blank, money glows. The gamblers sip the soup and feel **pure** for the first time.

The {Shepherd} pops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Piazza} and the sun blazes: it's high *summer*. Fountains sizzle, ice creams melt, and his sheep shed their wool in a fluffy blizzard. The shepherd spreads a towel on the cobbles and declares **summer** officially open, with sheep in sunglasses enjoying **summer**.

The {Robot} sits in the {Basement} of the {Funfair}, where a *blade edge* tickles his metal *heart*. It's itchy and annoying, but he must **endure** it: clowns honk at him, children poke him, a goat chews his antenna. He **endures** everything with a polite beep and a twitching eyebrow.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} and finds one giant *page* on the floor. She reads the **page**, turns it over, and it turns into a flying carpet. Words tumble off as she flies, and villagers catch them in buckets, each word taking a whole **page** to itself.

The {Juggler} bounds up the {Staircase} of the {Yeti Cave}, where a fallen *tree* is burning down to glowing *embers*. Trapped yetis whimper. She juggles the embers out the window, carries a yeti on each shoulder and saves the day. A **hero**! The yetis chant "**hero**" and give her a medal made of ice.

The {Jockey} rides through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} hauling poles of *bamboo* and a wooden *brace*. She **builds** a tower in the deep end: a diving board, then a castle, then a whole skyscraper. Swimmers climb it, and she keeps **building** until it pokes the moon.

The {Jockey} gallops up the {Staircase} of the {Hut} with a twig and a *snapped stick* in her hand, and everything she touches **breaks**: snap goes the banister, crack goes the chair, crunch goes the teapot. Her horse sneezes and **breaks** the window, and now the hut is mostly kindling.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Jungle} carrying a *pitcher* of lemonade for Mr **Zheng**, a famous explorer who lives in a tree. He drinks it all, burps loudly, and carves his name into a banana: **Zheng**. Monkeys copy it everywhere.

The {Baker} plunges through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} house into the water, and an enormous *shell* snaps shut on his hat. He prises it open with a baguette: inside is a pearl the size of a melon. He keeps the **shell** as a bath, and floats across the lake in the **shell**.

The {Zookeeper} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Casino} and raises a glass in a *toast* to the oldest tortoise in the world. Everyone bows. Gamblers take off their hats to **respect** him, the dice fall silent, and the tortoise blinks slowly, accepting all that **respect**.

The {Wizard} clatters up the {Staircase} of the {Pool} chasing a *loudmouth* named Mr **Wu**, who shouts his own name on every step. "**Wu**! Wu! Wu!" The swimmers chant along like an owl choir. The wizard shrinks him with a spell, but tiny Mr Wu is even louder.

The {Shepherd} rises through the {Trapdoor} of the {Youth Hostel} balancing a single pink *blossom* on his crook. He twirls, he pirouettes, he leaps over bunk beds. He is **graceful**, impossibly graceful, and the backpackers sigh. Even his sheep tiptoe behind him in a **graceful** line.

The {Hunter} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Casino} into a huge bowl and starts to **mix**: *water drops*, poker chips, playing cards and a swarm of *insect* gamblers. He stirs and stirs with a rifle. Everything gets **mixed** up, and the insects start playing poker with soggy cards.

The {Chef} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Funfair} helter-skelter, where a *minister* in robes is checking tickets. He's a royal **official**, stamping papers, inspecting candy floss and fining the dodgems. The chef serves him a hot dog, and the **official** stamps it "approved".

The {Yogi} glides into the {Basement} of the {Spa}, where a *sparrow* with a single silver *fang* sips tea from a thimble. It's terribly **elegant**: tiny pearls, a silk shawl, a pinky raised. The yogi tries to copy it, and spills tea on her nose, much less **elegant**.

The {Jockey} plunges through the {Trapdoor} of the {Funfair} and a *helping hand* grabs a giant *clam* and **shakes** it like a maraca. Pearls rattle out, the carousel spins faster, and the ferris wheel jiggles. The jockey's teeth chatter; the hand keeps **shaking** until the funfair hums.

The {Robot} clanks into the {Basement} of the {Mansion}, where a *mountain spring* bubbles purple. He dips a whole *tree* into it, then the curtains, then the butler. Everything gets **dyed**: purple sheep, purple walls, purple soup. The robot **dyes** himself last and shines like a giant grape.

The {Sheriff} plunges through the {Trapdoor} of the {Jungle} temple holding a golden *trophy* and a *dish* piled with mangoes. Wherever she sets them down, fruit trees sprout, flowers bloom and villages grow. Everything is **flourishing**; the jungle is so **flourishing** that the vines start building houses.

The {Ninja} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} onto a poor *drudge* scrubbing tiles. The drudge's *heart* swells with **anger**. He goes red, steam pours from his ears and the pool boils. His **anger** blows the diving board into orbit, and the ninja apologises in a hurry.

The {Wizard} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, waves his wand, and his slippers grow *dancing feet*. He starts to **dance**: tango, twist, moonwalk. The mop joins in, then the lifeguard, then the water itself, which **dances** in waves up and down the walls.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mint}, where an *employee* is building a *fence* around a giant coin. Everything is **round**: round fence, round coins, round guards. She rolls up into a round ball and bounces down the stairs, followed by a hundred **round** coins.

The {Gardener} trudges into the {Basement} of the {Tower} with a mile-long to-do list. A *helping hand* pops out of the wall and asks "What shall I **do**?" It does everything: polishes the *tower*, waters the cellar, weeds the stairs. Then it **does** the gardener's hair.

The {King} squelches up the {Staircase} of the {Swamp} castle, chased by a *mad dog* wearing a crown. It barks at frogs, bites logs and howls at teapots. The king catches the madness and goes **mad** too, dancing in the mud, sending royal decrees to the mosquitoes, utterly **mad**.

The {Tsar} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} where a mountain of *sun-dried meat* has toppled. A *helping hand* swoops in to **handle** it: stacks, wraps, labels. The tsar barks orders, and the hand **handles** him too, folding him neatly into a crate.

The {Shepherd} pops up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boxing Ring}, where a *woman* holds a little *seedling* and announces it needs a **surname**. The crowd shouts suggestions: Punch, Mudge, Sprout. The shepherd yells "Wool!" and the seedling sprouts a fluffy **surname** tag.

The {Tsar} stomps up the {Staircase} of the {Mansion}, followed by a clattering *skeleton* waving *twin blades*. They **destroy** everything: vases shattered, curtains shredded, the piano chopped into toothpicks. The skeleton is having so much fun it **destroys** its own leg and hops.

The {Cheerleader} leaps onto the {Rooftop} of the {Youth Hostel} and shakes her pom-poms, and red and gold leaves come pouring out. It's suddenly *autumn*. Backpackers rake leaves off their bunks, squirrels hoard their socks and a pumpkin rolls down the stairs. She cheers "Go **autumn**!" and the trees drop every leaf for **autumn**.

The {Pirate} kneels on the {Staircase} of the {Lake} house, heaping *soil* around a sad little seed. A *spitting mouth* carved in the wall sprays water on it every hour. He **cultivates** it with sea shanties and rum-scented compost. It grows into a palm tree, and he **cultivates** coconuts on the stairs.

The {Magician} wanders down the {Staircase} of the {Beach} hotel with a *lost traveller* clutching a map upside down. They try left, then right, then a secret door. Every exit leads back to the stairs. They are both **lost**, and the magician makes the map vanish, so now they are truly **lost**.

The {Chef} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} lodge holding a golden *trophy* and a *small speech bubble* that says "I really mean it." He is **sincere**: he hands the trophy to the monkey who stole his bananas. The monkey weeps. Even the parrots feel how **sincere** he is and stop swearing.

The {King} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Swan Pond} pavilion and pulls the *roof* wider and wider, like dough. Purple *amaranth* flowers spill over the edges. The roof becomes so **wide** that it covers the pond, the park and the city. Swans skate on it, and the king rolls across the **wide** tiles like a bowling ball.

The {Yogi} floats into the {Basement} of the {Museum}, where a dusty *coat stand* is propping up a crumbling *roof*. She lifts the roof off and finds the whole **universe** hidden underneath: planets, comets, a galaxy shaped like a teapot. She hangs Saturn on the coat stand and naps in the middle of the **universe**.

The {Magician} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Jungle} hut, where a *prowling dog* guards a sleeping *firstborn* tiger cub. The dog snarls, foam flying, **fierce** as a dragon. The magician pulls out a rabbit, the dog eats the hat, and the cub wakes up even more **fierce**, roaring a tiny roar.

The {Baker} kneels in the {Basement} of the {Island} hut, where a *dropped net* has scattered shells and starfish everywhere. A *helping hand* helps him **arrange** them in rows: big shells, small shells, rainbow shells. He **arranges** them into a perfect cake shape, then eats the one made of sugar.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Lake} house to a *tree* heavy with purple **plum** fruit. A *busy mother* rushes past with baskets, picking, pitting, jamming. The magician pulls a plum from her ear, then a dozen, and soon every stair is sticky with **plum** jam.

The {Hunter} swings a huge *war club* in the {Basement} of the {Waiting Room}. Crash! The magazines fly. Bang! The chairs explode. He **destroys** the clock, the vending machine, the potted fern. The receptionist calmly takes his name, and he **destroys** the pen too.

The {Sheriff} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Funfair}, where a *standing person* skewered on a giant *skewer* begins to **stretch**. His arms stretch to the rollercoaster, his neck to the ferris wheel. He **stretches** so far he can tickle the clouds and ring the bell on the high striker.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Fort} with a scratchy bundle of *hemp* in one *hand*. He **rubs** a cannon with it until it shines and a genie pops out. The genie **rubs** its eyes, grumbles, and grants him a wish: a fort-sized bubble bath.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} treehouse to a *dish* glowing with the *sun and moon* side by side. Every animal crowds round: lions, monkeys, ants. They shake paws over the dish and form an **alliance** against mosquitoes. The magician seals the **alliance** with a fizzing firework.

The {Magician} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Fort} and climbs to the very *treetop* of the tallest pine. He keeps climbing until there's no tree left: the **end**. He waves a flag at the very **end** of the world, where the sky is held up by string.

The {Ninja} slides into the {Basement} of the {Island} cave and finds a ribbon spelling out a riddle: "Who are you **to be**?" The *ribbon* wraps around him and ties him into a parcel labelled "ninja". So that's what he is **to be**: a present, delivered to the island's crab king.

The {Baker} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Lake} house, so **sad** that his *heart* droops like a wet sock. A bird with *spread wings* lands beside him and sobs too. Their tears fill the gutters and the lake rises. Even the bread is **sad**, sagging and soggy.

The {Pirate} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Island} fort and starts to *clap*. His parrot joins in, then the crabs, then the coconuts thumping on the sand. The whole island begins **clapping**, the palm trees too. They **clap** so hard that a passing ship turns round to take a bow.

The {Dentist} hops onto the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring} and hammers a giant *nail* into the beam. It wobbles, sprouts arms and legs and becomes a skinny little **man**. He spars with the boxers, bending but never falling. Everyone cheers for the **man** made from a nail.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} on a racing *runner* holding a pair of *scissors*. He snips the finish ribbon early and **surpasses** every rival. Then he **surpasses** the clouds, the moon, and finally himself, overtaking his own shadow in a cloud of sparks.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boxing Ring} and lands head-first on a *stone*. BONG! It rings like a *gong*. Her head is **hard**, the stone is **hard**, and the boxers' gloves bounce off them both. She meditates on the stone, which gradually turns into a cushion out of politeness.

The {Magician} pops up through the {Trapdoor} on the {Island} with a pile of *seedling top* sprouts and *trudging feet* covered in mud. Wherever he walks, **wheat** springs up: golden, waving, rustling. By sunset the island is an ocean of **wheat**, and the coconuts are confused.

The {Juggler} skids into the {Basement} of the {Stadium}, where a stern *general* named **Jiang** lies hidden in tall *grass*, planning a parade. She juggles his medals. He's furious, then delighted, and General **Jiang** promotes her to Chief Juggler of the army.

The {Tsar} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} as a flock of birds flies past in a riot of *birdsong*. A giant *helping hand* reaches out and **grasps** one tune right out of the air. The tsar **grasps** it too and keeps it in his crown, so he hums all day.

The {Yogi} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Hut} on a tiny *hillside* of pillows, cupping one *ear* to the wind. Every echo comes back "**ye**!" She shouts "ye!", the mountains shout "**ye**!", and the whole valley goes "ye, ye, ye" like an excited choir of goats.

The {Zookeeper} wedges a *stepladder* across the {Basement} of the {Pool}, then piles a *hillside* of sandbags behind it. She **blocks** the drain, the door and the escaping penguins. A walrus tries to squeeze through, and she **blocks** him with her own belly.

The {Dentist} plunges through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boxing Ring} with a *small speech bubble* saying "Reserved". She hammers a *nail* through it into the best seat. She **books** the front row, then the ring, then the boxers, and **books** an appointment to check their teeth.

The {Tsar} tumbles into the {Basement} of the {Island} cave, where a *fruit picker* paints the walls with *bristles* of a giant brush. Red, gold, turquoise! **Colour** splashes everywhere: on the bats, the stalactites, the tsar's beard. He sneezes and a rainbow of **colour** shoots out of his nose.

The {Chef} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse}, where a *sprouting field* of carrots grows in the gutters. A giant *helping hand* reaches down and **pulls out** a carrot, then another, then a pirate, then a whole boat. The chef keeps **pulling out** things until the boathouse is empty.

The {Zookeeper} pops out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} to watch *two racers* sprint for a golden *shell*. They tie! She **praises** them both so loudly that the chandelier rattles. The butler **praises** them too, the dogs bark praise, and the racers blush like tomatoes.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Fort} and finds a *ghost* wrapped in a cloak of *hemp*, horns poking out. It's a **devil**, grinning, juggling fireballs. The magician tries a disappearing trick, but the **devil** makes the magician disappear first, and laughs from the battlements.

The {Firefighter} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Funfair} slicing a giant *cut cake* while a spool of *silk thread* streams ribbons into the wind. Confetti, balloons, cake crumbs, flags: **numerous** things whirl everywhere. She tries to count them, but they're too **numerous**, so she hoses them into a rainbow.

The {Yogi} walks down the {Staircase} of the {Mansion}, following a trail of *water drops* **along** the hallway, **along** the kitchen and out the door. They lead along the river to a duck dripping in a dressing gown. She walks along with it, meditating at every puddle.

The {Hunter} stumbles into the {Basement} of the {Mansion}, gets a mouthful of *salt* by mistake and opens his *mouth* to **shout**. "AAARGH!" The windows shatter, the wine bottles pop and the butler's wig blows off. He **shouts** so loud that the whole mansion jumps three feet.

The {Wizard} bounds up the {Staircase} of the {Lake} house, wearing a *leather strap* of rules: no spells, no running on the *road*, no frogs in the kitchen. He **disobeys** them all at once: spells, sprinting, frogs everywhere. He even **disobeys** the stairs and walks up the banister.

The {Magician} pops up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} house with his **younger sister**, a tiny *woman* holding a *sapling*. She plants it in his hat. It grows! His **younger sister** giggles, climbs the tree and pulls rabbits out of his hair.

The {Lifeguard} slides through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} with a *good meal* on a tray, as *water drops* turn into a roaring **wave**. It crashes through the hangar, lifting jets like toy boats. She surfs the **wave** on her tray, never spilling a single noodle.

The {Hunter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room}, where *water drops* drip from every tap into one *open crate*. Rivers of patients, magazines and rubber ducks all **converge** on the crate. The streams **converge** so fast the crate fills, floats, and sails into the doctor's office.

The {Baker} slides down a giant *slide* through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Beach}, landing on a *towel* covered in golden **coins**. He flips one: heads, he gets a cake; tails, a seagull steals his hat. Every **coin** lands on its edge, spinning forever.

The {Firefighter} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} lodge and plants a single stalk of *wheat*. Boom! Crops burst out everywhere: mangoes, rice, pumpkins, a mountain of bread. The harvest is **abundant**, so **abundant** that monkeys sell snacks to tourists and the lodge sinks under the fruit.

The {Lifeguard} jogs up the {Staircase} of the {Mansion}, where an *inspector* in a trench coat is painting the *grass* bright **blue**. She blows her whistle, but he paints her blue too, then the stairs, then the sky. The mansion is now completely **blue**, and so is the inspector's tongue.

The {Sheriff} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Pool}, where a *skeleton* coated in shiny *red lacquer* is diving in. It's a **special** guest: it does a triple somersault and lands as a pile of bones that rebuild themselves. The judges hold up a **special** score: eleven out of ten.

The {Shepherd} rises through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} with a *dog* wearing a hat that points *south*. He kneels before the bankers to **offer** them the dog. They refuse. He **offers** the sheep, the hat and a sandwich, and finally they accept a single wagging tail.

The {Jockey} on the {Rooftop} of the {Warehouse} saws a fallen *tree* in half and nails four legs on. It's a **table**! She serves a feast on it: pies, tea, a whole roast turkey. Pigeons sit round the **table** in tiny chairs, and the horse lies under it.

The {Lifeguard} lounges on the {Front Step} of the {Spa}, humming "**la**, la, la". A *pulling hand* tugs her *mouth* into a big grin and the song goes louder. Every guest joins in, "**la** la la!", until the steam rooms sing along.

The {Wizard} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Spa} and lifts a loose *tile* from the floor. Underneath is another **tile**, and another, a stack a mile deep. He builds a tile staircase out of them and climbs out through the roof, stacking each **tile** with a magic click.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Island} hut, where a goat munches *grass* and *barley*. In the middle grows a scruffy weed: **goosefoot**, with leaves shaped like little webbed feet. Geese waddle in to compare. The lifeguard blows her whistle, and the **goosefoot** waddles off on its own.

The {Yogi} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Mint}, when a banker falls into the coin vault. She throws a *rescue rope* and a *helping hand* to **help** him out. Then she **helps** the coins, a lost cat and a confused printing press, pulling them all to safety in perfect lotus pose.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} hut where a crab and a seagull are arguing, each word popping out in a *small speech bubble*. She **translates**: "He says your feet smell." The seagull squawks; she **translates** that too. Soon she's translating the waves and the sand.

The {Dentist} storms up the {Staircase} of the {Warehouse} to **seize** a giant toothbrush from a *big man* who's been hogging it. She pins him down with one *thumb*, grabs the brush, and **seizes** his candy stash too, waving it in triumph.

The {Cheerleader} bursts through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} sauna, where *water drops* sizzle on hot stones and hissing *steam* billows out. She can't see her pom-poms. **Steam** fogs the sea, the gulls, the lighthouse. A train chugs out of the cloud, powered entirely by **steam** and cheering.
